channels.name: RE_n / RE_t / W/R_n
channels.purpose: Read Enable / NV-DDR3 differential / NV-DDR direction; shared pin.

channels.name: WP_n
channels.purpose: Write Protect; disables Program/Erase when LOW.

channels.name: ZQ
channels.purpose: ZQ Calibration reference; tied to Vss via RZQ.

global_signals.name: VREFQ
global_signals.purpose: Input reference voltage shared across DQ + DQS (NV-DDR2/3).

handshake_pairs.name: CMD_LATCH
handshake_pairs.rule: CLE=1, ALE=0, WE_n rising → DQ = opcode.

handshake_pairs.name: ADDR_LATCH
handshake_pairs.rule: CLE=0, ALE=1, WE_n rising → DQ = address byte.

handshake_pairs.name: WRITE_DATA_LATCH
handshake_pairs.rule: CLE=0, ALE=0, WE_n rising (SDR) or DQS edge (NV-DDR) → DQ = write byte.

handshake_pairs.name: READ_DATA_DRIVE
handshake_pairs.rule: CLE=0, ALE=0, RE_n falling (SDR) or RE_t/RE_c + DQS edges (NV-DDR) → device drives DQ.

handshake_pairs.name: BUSY_INDICATION
handshake_pairs.rule: Any LUN busy → R/B_n LOW; all LUNs ready → R/B_n HIGH (external pull-up).

handshake_pairs.name: STATUS_POLL
handshake_pairs.rule: 70h or 78h + 3 row addr → device drives status byte on next RE_n falling (SDR) or DQS edges (NV-DDR).

dependency_graph.common_rule: Host drives all strobes; device drives R/B_n. CLE/ALE select cycle type; WE_n rising (SDR) or CLK rising (NV-DDR) latches cmd/addr; RE_n falling or DQS edges drive read data.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Address cycles depend on preceding command. Data cycles depend on most recent cmd + addr + active data interface. R/B_n LOW gates new commands.

power_pins.name: VDDi
power_pins.purpose: EZ NAND internal regulator stabilizing pin.

pin_sharing_map.description: WE_n carries CLK in NV-DDR; reverts to WE_n in NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3.
RE_n carries W/R_n in NV-DDR; RE_t in NV-DDR3 differential.

ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_dq: 8-bit DQ carries one byte per cycle; multi-byte fields LSB-first.
ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_x16: x16 DQ carries 16-bit word per cycle; DQ[7:0] low, DQ[15:8] high.
ordering_rules.address_byte_order: Read/Program: C1 (col LSB), C2 (col MSB), R1 (row LSB), R2 (row mid), R3 (row MSB). Erase: R1, R2, R3 only.
